pitches.name: Sofia
pitches.why: It's a cheerful, instantly recognisable farm animal that isn't eaten, so it fits the vegetarian café, and it nods to the owner's former donkey. Long ears make it easy for blind judges to recognise in domino form.

pitches.name: Omar
pitches.why: A chick is small, friendly and cheerful, instantly recognisable, and fits a farm café window without being a big farm beast. Its round body and little beak should also be easy to build from dominoes.

pitches.name: Hana
pitches.why: The client's own hens wander among the tables and the kids love them, so it's personal, cheerful and instantly recognisable on a farm café window. A chicken's silhouette (comb, beak, round body, tail) is also distinctive enough for blind judges to identify.

pitches.name: Jack
pitches.why: The café is on a farm and famous for eggs and egg custard tarts, so a chicken ties directly to their brand, is cheerful, and is instantly recognisable even in blocky domino form.
